name: Angled Spreadface
description: Sets the feet shoulder-wide and holds the folded fan across the chest with both hands to cover the front line.

name: Rimribblow
description: Drives the closed tip straight into the opponent's floating ribs with a short step and pulls it back at once.

name: Fantipcowl
description: Swings the closed spine outward across the body to knock a thrown punch off its line.

name: Light Snapshut
description: Slides the lead foot one pace forward while the fan stays level so the stance never opens.

name: Pulling Fantip
description: Snaps the wrist to flick the fan open in the opponent's face and break the rhythm of a rush.

name: Fantipdrop
description: Swings the closed fan in slow arcs from shoulder to hip to loosen the wrist and learn its weight.

name: Fanspine Hit
description: Pokes the closed tip at the hollow above the collarbone and recovers the elbow before a counter can land.

name: Hooding Foldedge
description: Crosses both forearms behind the folded fan and takes a blow on the rib bundle instead of the wrist.

name: Stepping Flutter
description: Steps back out of reach while the fan hand returns to its guard position at the belt.

name: Pulling Fanrib
description: Lifts the opened leaf to hide the eyes and shoulders for a heartbeat before the real move arrives.

name: Quick Rustle
description: Hooks the folded fan behind the lead ankle and pulls sharply so the opponent's weight slips.

name: Fantiplid
description: Rolls the wrist in tight circles to spin the open fan and brush aside a flurry of light blows.

name: Rivetpin Hit
description: Slashes the outer rib across the opponent's forearm in a short forward arc.

name: Fanribstrike
description: Brings the fan back along the same line and cuts again with the rear rib as the wrist turns over.

name: Waft Trot
description: Turns the hip away from a thrust and draws the fan hand with it so the body leaves the line.

name: Nabbing Guardrib
description: Shakes the half-open leaf near the opponent's eyes so a real strike from the other hand goes unseen.

name: Wavering Husk
description: Catches the opponent's wrist in the notch between two ribs and holds it for a moment.

name: Raised Silkface
description: Throws the opened fan up before the face and chest to take a swinging blow on the metal ribs.

name: Raised Rimrib
description: Raises the fan flat above the head so a downward club blow lands on the iron ribs.

name: Nabbing Pivotpin
description: Hooks the pivot end around a wrist and pulls it across the body to lock the arm.

name: Wafthit
description: Chops the weighted outer rib straight down onto the shoulder or the back of the hand.

name: Rustleblow
description: Whips the outer rib upward from the hip along the inside of the thigh and the ribs.

name: Downward Silkface
description: Locks the folded fan in both hands and thrusts the tip at the belly like a short spear.

name: Foldedge Cowl
description: Twists the fan on its rivet as a blade arrives so the edge slides down the ribs and away.

name: Fanrib Skitter
description: Shuffles the feet around a quarter circle to stand on the opponent's weak side.

name: Folded Rimrib
description: Sinks into a low stance and holds the fan flat over the head to shed a rain of blows.

name: Firm Fanspine
description: Snaps the open fan shut against the palm and thrusts the closed tip forward in one motion.

name: Fanoutdash
description: Opens the fan close to the face so the outer rib rakes across the opponent's cheek.

name: Tight Rivetpin
description: Folds the fan mid-block so a striking arm slides along the closed ribs and past the body.

name: Backward Rustle
description: Spins the opened fan once in front of the chest while stepping off the centre line.

name: Catching Snapshut
description: Spreads the polished leaf into the light so the glare catches the opponent's eyes.

name: Quick Waft
description: Folds the fan on a downswing so the bundled ribs knock hard against the collarbone.

name: Kept Guardrib
description: Circulates a thread of qi along the opened ribs to harden the leaf against thrown blades.

name: Fantip Stay
description: Slaps the guard rib against an incoming wrist to push the whole strike wide.

name: Easing Flutter
description: Steps backward behind the opened leaf so the retreating legs stay hidden from view.

name: Square Wavering
description: Thrusts the folded ribs into the pit of the stomach with a breath of qi behind the wrist.

name: Ready Spreadface
description: Braces the free palm against the back of the fan to hold the guard under a heavy blow.

name: Single Foldedge
description: Crosses one foot over the other and slashes the outer rib diagonally from shoulder to hip.

name: Fantipskitter
description: Spins on the ball of the foot as the fan hand trails the turn and slips past a lunge.

name: Fanribbump
description: Drags the sharpened outer rib along the opponent's wrist to open the grip on a weapon.

name: Kept Fantip
description: Lets a cut slide across the open leaf and out past the shoulder without meeting the ribs.

name: Rimribcowl
description: Flicks the hanging tassel at the opponent's eyes so the gaze drops for a moment.

name: Descending Fanout
description: Presses the closed tip under the jaw to stop a forward rush and force the head back.

name: Fanoutbump
description: Backs away while beating the closed spine across the pursuer's knuckles to slow the chase.

name: Rustlestrike
description: Slices the open edge flat across at throat height in one clean level arc.

name: Flat Rivetpin
description: Cuts upward from the low guard so the fan edge passes through the inside of the forearm.

name: Angled Rimrib
description: Catches a knife thrust between two ribs and twists the point aside.

name: Stepping Snapshut
description: Creeps forward in small gliding steps behind a slowly lowering fan until the range is closed.

name: Nimble Rustle
description: Pulls the lead heel back while the fan sweeps across to cover the retreat.

name: Fanout Drop
description: Dabs the folded tip toward the eyes so the opponent blinks and loses sight of the other hand.

name: Fanriblid
description: Hooks the half-open ribs over a weapon hand and drags the arm down out of line.

name: Descending Fanspine
description: Flicks the open fan back through the same cut with the reverse edge before the first arc ends.

name: Hooding Pivotpin
description: Holds the fan fully open before the chest and walks forward behind it against steady blows.

name: Firm Silkface
description: Sweeps the open fan leftward across the opponent's face with a breath of qi through the wrist.

name: Skipping Guardrib
description: Opens the fan like a wing on the far side and steps sideways around the incoming charge.

name: Gnawing Flutter
description: Chops the outer rib down on the wrist that holds a weapon until the fingers loosen.

name: Raised Fanrib
description: Folds the fan under the arm and levers a low thrust upward and away from the hip.

name: Fanoutstay
description: Rattles the ribs hard beside the ear to break the focus of an opponent mid-draw.

name: Fanrib Cowl
description: Lifts the guard rib to meet a downward cut and angles it off the shoulder.

name: Fanribpause
description: Sweeps the open leaf low across the shins to turn aside a kick or a low cut.

name: Fantippause
description: Raps the closed spine on the flat of a sword so the blade rings and swings wide.

name: Lowered Pivotpin
description: Turns the wrist twice in a row to keep the opened leaf between the body and a flurry.

name: Fantipblow
description: Answers a parry by rapping the rib tips sharply across the opponent's knuckles.

name: Fanoutlid
description: Snaps the fan shut around a passing hand so the ribs pinch the fingers together.

name: Fanout Trot
description: Slides the rear foot up after a parry so the fan hand is already inside striking range.

name: Planted Fantip
description: Holds the shut fan like a short staff across the body and takes a cut on its metal sheath.

name: Level Pivotpin
description: Reverses the shut fan and jabs the heavy pivot end back into an opponent behind the hip.

name: Fantipwedge
description: Rolls the shut fan over the forearm to send a thrust past the shoulder.

name: Rustledodge
description: Slides forward along the line of the shut fan so the body follows its reach.

name: Pulling Rivetpin
description: Hooks the tip of the shut fan on a weapon guard and tugs it off its line.
